$comment: Copy this file (e.g. to config/my-pull.json, which is gitignored) and fill it in, then pass it to Invoke-EDiscoveryExport.ps1 -ConfigFile. See docs/authentication-setup.md for the auth block.
$comment-extends: OPTIONAL. Inherit from a tenant profile instead of restating shared settings in every
matter: "extends": "../ediscovery-tenant-profile.json". The path is resolved relative to
THIS file. Objects deep-merge (so auth can override just certThumbprint) while arrays and
scalars are replaced wholesale. Chains are allowed; cycles throw. A profile need not be a
complete run config - only the merged result is validated.
Recommended for any tenant that runs more than one matter: put auth + members + conventions
in the profile, and keep case/search/mailboxes/output per matter. Cert rotation then touches
one file instead of every matter config ever written.

matter.$comment: OPTIONAL provenance, e.g. 'Zammad #6808' or 'Matter-1234'. Printed in the run header and written into every run manifest, so an exported package can be traced back to the request that justified it.

search.name: Keyword Search
search.$comment: Each keyword element becomes an OR'd KQL group, e.g. ['contract dispute'] -> (contract dispute). Set contentQuery to raw KQL to override keywords+dates entirely.

export.$comment: singlePst:false adds 'splitSource' for one PST per mailbox. format: pst or msg. friendlyNames adds the 'friendlyName' option: for msg it names each file after the email subject instead of a GUID, and it does nothing for pst (subjects are kept inside the PST either way). Leave null to default it ON for msg and off for pst; set false only to deliberately keep GUID names.

auth.$comment: mode: app-only | interactive. Fill appId/tenantId with your Entra app + tenant, certThumbprint with your cert in the store (or set certPath to a .pfx + certPasswordEnv naming an env var with its password). downloadResourceAppId is the Microsoft first-party Purview eDiscovery download resource - the same GUID for every tenant; leave it as-is. Full setup: docs/authentication-setup.md.
